_what: Hand-written <title> and <meta name=description> for the pages that already earn search impressions. Applied by fix-meta.py, which is re-runnable so a page rebuild cannot silently lose these.
_why: GSC 20 Jun — 19 Sep 2026: average position 8 but CTR 1.1%. Position 8 normally earns 2-3%, so roughly half to two thirds of the clicks the ranking already deserves are being lost at the SERP. Every title below was 66-118 characters and every description 153-304, so Google was truncating both mid-phrase.
_rules: title <= 60 characters, brand or primary query FIRST

no site-name suffix on article pages — Google renders the site name on its own line above the title, so repeating it spent 19 characters to say nothing. The homepage keeps it, because that is the page Google derives the site name FROM.
house rules still apply: no banned word, no ranking other brands down, no selection-criteria explainers
